title: Add archived update preservation step to GitHub Actions deploy
description: GitHub Pages artifact deployment replaces the ENTIRE site. Add a workflow step that preserves archived update directories before deploy. Strategy: (1) For each archived update in update_config.json, download its content from the live site (or restore from a GitHub Actions artifact). (2) Upload each archived update as a persistent artifact (u48-archive.tar.gz) with 90-day retention. (3) Restore archived artifacts into output/ before the Pages upload step. This prevents U48 content from being lost when U49 deploys.

The goal: after this change merges to main, NOTHING runs automatically. The site is frozen.
